name: Equinox signs
story: A deceptively fine morning, then every sign of what is coming: a halo round the sun, high cloud thickening fast, the wind backing southeast and rising through the evening, the barometer falling steeply. Bring the aeroplanes in.
forecast: Fair morning, high cloud thickening from 11:00. Southeast 6 kt, rising to 14 kt by midnight. Pressure falling fast. GALE WARNING for tomorrow: no flying from dawn to 18:00.
